description: A dataset's variables or properties (standard names, units, categories, bands, aggregates), horizon, step, cadence, freshness, cost class, verified `examples` and an example_query to read its values; a map layer's axes (source, region, facts) and render (visual) call. Free. Call it when a grid or snapshot hit's `call` lacks the variable you need (with no `variable`, it may read only the headline one), or to check units, horizon or cost; not needed when the hit's `call` already names what you need: run that. Example: {"dataset_id": "<from search_data>"}.

dataset_id.description: A dataset id from search_data or get_data (1-80 chars).

name: describe_data

attribution.description: Attribution the dataset licence requires. Cite it when quoting these values.

data_status.description: Present only when the data service could not answer: a cached copy, or catalog facts without freshness.

example_query.description: get_data arguments for this dataset; add a location.

map.description: Its map (its own layer, or the one search_data's `map` names): axes, sibling sectors, `select` (an id and its <family>:<pick>, or a standard name), the render (visual) call, and a note.

title: Describe data
